name: Approximated Gradient Back-Propagation
definition: A method to compute gradients for optimization by ignoring high-order gradient terms (dependence of point positions on latent code z) to reduce memory usage, using only the direct gradient of the SDF function.
summary: Approximated Gradient Back-Propagation computes gradients in differentiable volume rendering by ignoring high-order terms to reduce memory usage, distinguishing itself from exact methods by using only the direct gradient of the Signed Distance Function network.
